verdict.rationale: Letta's docs describe rich memory management (memory blocks, MemFS, /doctor auditing system-prompt token usage, dreaming/consolidation, semantic search mods) but nowhere document a single API call that returns a token-budgeted, prompt-ready context block assembled from relevant memories for use outside the agent's own turn. The SDK exposes session.send()/stream() for running the agent, not a standalone 'get context' retrieval endpoint.
